articles.title: Prime Minister Carney announces first-ever Canada Investment Summit
articles.mainIdea: Prime Minister Carney announces first-ever Canada Investment Summit
articles.summary: CNW Group: Prime Minister Carney announces first-ever Canada Investment Summit. The world is changing rapidly. In response, Canada's new government is focused on what we can control. We are building a stronger economy with an ambitious plan to catalyse $1 trillion in total investment in Canada over the next five years.

articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: This Week In Electric Vehicles - Driving Change: Analyzing the Future of Automotive Innovation. The global electric vehicle (EV) market is experiencing significant transformation driven by geopolitical factors, regulatory changes, and shifts in consumer preferences. Amid these changes, automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) are re-evaluating electrification goals, focusing on mass-market EV development and the integration of alternative battery chemistries and 800V architecture to boost adoption.
